# Hubble 2.2.3 beta 7

- **Wide key faces on a Stream Deck Studio.** On Companion 5, Hubble now draws each key face in the shape of the device chosen for its page in **Button layout**. On a **Stream Deck Studio** page the face is wide and fills the Studio's wider keys from edge to edge. Before, it was drawn narrower and slightly soft, and it dimmed the key's text.
  - Pages for other decks get square faces drawn at that deck's own key size (96 × 96 on an XL), so they stay sharp. A page with no device chosen uses 96 × 96.
  - To draw every page wide, open the Hubble connection's settings in Companion and set **Key shape** to **Stream Deck Studio (wide) on every page**.
  - Companion 4 draws every key square, so on Companion 4 the faces look the same as before.
- **Button layout shows a Stream Deck Studio page with wide keys.** The keys are as wide as they are on the device. Dials stay round.
- **Updating the Hubble module in Companion no longer stops timed keys from syncing.** When Companion updated the Hubble module, it marked every Hubble action as upgraded. Hubble read that as someone having edited the keys, so it stopped saving workbook changes to keys with long presses and showed "A managed Hubble action was edited". Hubble now ignores that mark, and it still notices a real edit.

This beta includes version **0.3.7** of the Hubble module for Companion. To get the wide faces, choose **Install / Reinstall** in **Module Connections** or **Button layout**, or **Update in Companion** in Hubble → **Service Settings…**. When the module updates, Companion adds a **Key page** field to each Hubble key's appearance. Leave it as it is.

Nothing in your configuration changes. This beta opens the same configuration as 2.2.3 beta 6.

This is a beta. It reaches Macs that have turned on **Get beta updates** in Hubble's **Check for Updates…** window.
